verdict.rationale: The only related evidence is Notion Skills: a user-owned page of instructions for a repeatable workflow that you or an assistant can maintain. This is a manual way to steer AI output toward your preferences, and Custom Agents exist, but nothing shows the in-app assistant learning tone or shorthand on its own. Missing for 10: evidence of automatic learning of the user's tone and writing style, shorthand or personal vocabulary handling, persistent preference memory in the in-app AI, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
